source_failure: Close the affected source on HTTP errors, timeout, unexpected content or redirect; skip its remaining slots. Continue the other listed source only if global limits remain.
global_stop: Operator Stop, hard deadline, resource/request limit, integrity mismatch or ambiguous/invalid scope. Close active request and consume attempt. No retries or extensions.
discovery: At most three Kalshi and two US directly linked text/HTML documents from successful fixed pages; one hop only; no market search. Selection via stdin while 90-second clock continues. Missing/ambiguous links unused.
child_exclusions: No PDFs, query strings, credentials, redirects, APIs, market pages, search, mirrored schedule or challenge bypass. US generic rules never establish exact contract applicability on their own.
